account_end.equity_interval_note: equity = cash + reserved only if every open position is worth exactly what was reserved. Where open exposure cannot be priced the equity is an INTERVAL: lower bound cash (total loss of the open premium), upper bound cash + reserved + any unrealised gain, which is not computed here.
